limits.rule: The Packet is what you know, not the fence around what you may write. The approved facts and the ledger are canon: never contradict them, and never import real-world Oakland (its people, businesses, landmarks, troubles). Everything else — the scene, the street, the weather in the room, unnamed people and what they say, new in-world places and businesses, what the city is talking about — is yours to invent; that colour is the job, and it never rewrites a canon fact. A named ledger citizen speaks only in their approved quote or their own page line. For this investigation: do not invent official acts, requests, responses, files, duties, or offices for a named office or named citizen, and claim no reporting act (asked, requested, obtained, tracked) the record does not show. Attribute each approved quote exactly. Missing evidence stays unknown — never rewritten as "X did not happen," "no one did X," or "the absence proves X." Write 400-700 words as this reporter living the known condition. Do not print engine classifier names, severity labels, source row numbers, or a silence-clock section.
